title: US IRC section 121(a): ownership and use requirements of one taxpayer

source.entry_point: Us_tax_code scope Section121SinglePerson, output requirements_met (Python: generated.Us_tax_code.section121_single_person, Catala 1.3.0)

attributes.name: ownership_days_in_5_years
attributes.source: Section121SinglePerson.property_ownage (us_tax_code/section_121.catala_en:36), aggregated by aggregate_periods_from_last_five_years (us_tax_code/section_121.catala_en:179-191) and compared with 730 days (us_tax_code/section_121.catala_en:196-198; Treas. Reg. 1.121-1(c)(1)); 26 U.S.C. 121(a): owned for periods aggregating 2 years or more during the 5 years ending on the date of sale

attributes.name: use_days_in_5_years
attributes.source: Section121SinglePerson.property_usage_as_principal_residence (us_tax_code/section_121.catala_en:38-39), same aggregation, compared with 730 days (us_tax_code/section_121.catala_en:200-205); 26 U.S.C. 121(a): used as principal residence for periods aggregating 2 years or more

attributes.name: other_section_121a_sale
attributes.source: Section121SinglePerson.other_section_121a_sale, enumeration OtherSection121aSale (us_tax_code/section_121.catala_en:26-29, 48); read by section_121_b_3_applies (us_tax_code/section_121.catala_en:371-377); 26 U.S.C. 121(b)(3): one sale every 2 years. within_2_years: the earlier sale took place 1 day to 2 years before the date of sale; more_than_2_years: more than 2 years before

output.name: requirements_met
output.source: Section121SinglePerson.requirements_met (us_tax_code/section_121.catala_en:32, rule 207-209): ownership and use requirements of 26 U.S.C. 121(a) both met

date_of_sale_or_exchange.why: Data scope of the official tests (us_tax_code/tests/test_section_121.catala_en:19)

gain_from_sale_or_exchange_of_property.why: Data scope of the official tests (us_tax_code/tests/test_section_121.catala_en:21); requirements_met does not read it

gain_cap, section_121_b_3_applies (conte.why: the official tests do not redefine them

notes: Sub-table 1 of 2 of US-121. REJECTED rows: whenever another section 121(a) sale is given, the comparison `date_of_sale_or_exchange - other_sale.date_of_sale_or_exchange <= 2 year` (us_tax_code/section_121.catala_en:376) compares a duration in days with a duration in years, which Catala rejects at run time (DateError); the scope computes all its outputs, so requirements_met is not returned either. The Catala interpreter gives the same error (paperC/catala_more/probes/probe_b3_output.txt).
